subject: SCOTUS Draft Opinion Overturning Roe v. Wade
overview: The podcast hosts shared an update on local tenant displacement before holding a discussion on the leaked Supreme Court draft opinion overturning Roe v. Wade.

items.title: Bradley Road Tenant Association Press Release
items.summary: Danielle Balocca read a press release regarding Bradley Road residents rallying against mass no-fault notices to quit issued by landlord Savage Properties.

items.title: Discussion on SCOTUS Draft Opinion Overturning Roe v. Wade
items.summary: Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan discussed the leaked Supreme Court draft opinion reversing Roe v. Wade, addressing healthcare access, social equity, and ways for community members to take action.
